params.body:
## What

On Beheer > Inzichten > Gebruik the measure list is ten short names. A name alone does not say who acts or what one unit is, and the sentence that did only appeared under the chart after a measure was chosen.

Every measure now carries one quiet line under its name, in the list itself:

| Measure | Line (nl) |
|---|---|
| Handelingen | Wagens, offertes, bestelbonnen, biedingen, opvragingen en leads |
| Bewerkingen | Keren dat iemand van de garage een wagen bewaarde |
| Schermen geopend | Pagina's die mensen van de garage openden |
| Stocklist geopend | Keren dat iemand van de garage de gedeelde stocklist opende |
| Bekeken in stocklist | Wagens van collega's die de garage in de stocklist opende |
| Aanmeldingen | Keren dat iemand van de garage zich aanmeldde |
| Bekeken door collega's | Eigen wagens, geopend door collega's op het platform |
| Bekeken in widget | Eigen wagens, bekeken door bezoekers in de widget op de site |
| Bekeken op website | Eigen wagens, bekeken door bezoekers op de website (API) |
| Widget geopend | Keren dat een bezoeker de widget van de garage laadde |

## How

- A measure is a row group of two rows: its numbers, and the line under them over the full width of the row. The list is 420 px wide from 1280 px on, so a line inside the name column would wrap after some thirty characters. Measured in the browser in the four languages: one line at 1280 and 1440, at most two at 390.
- The row group is what is clicked, hovered and marked as chosen. Comparison columns, right-aligned tabular numbers and the first day are unchanged.
- One thin divider with a little air stands before the first measure about others (`Measures::REACH`). No head, no text; the garage table has none and keeps its short column heads without a legend.
- The chart shows the same line under its title for the chosen measure. The longer `said_*` sentences are removed in nl, fr, en and de. Two details they carried (filtering and scrolling do not count as opening the stocklist, own cars do not count as viewed in the stocklist) remain in rule P3-16.25.
- Each line is at most 64 characters in every language, which is what fits on one line at 12 px.

## Rules and tests

- P3-16.24 reworded for the line and the divider, P3-16.25 names its two lines, P3-16.13 no longer speaks of two groups.
- `WhatAGarageDoesIsNotWhatOthersDoWithItsCarsTest`: every measure renders its line under its name; a line in four languages within the cap, sentence case, no full stop, no em dash; the divider stands once, before the first measure about others, with nothing but markup around it; the chart carries the same line; the four language files carry the same keys; no native tooltip.

## Checked

- Full suite locally: 2757 tests green (run on the branch stacked on this one).
- PHPStan: no errors.
params.title: Activity: every measure says under its name what it counts
